title: Table cell selector ignores decimalPlaces under short style
answers: Short style table cell with retained decimal places
Why is short style not using decimalPlaces in tables
body: In dataVisualizationLogic.ts tabularData selector, the decimalPlaces branch applies only when `decimalPlaces != null && style !== 'short'`. A retained decimalPlaces under short style is ignored (12.345 shows as 12.3), matching the settings panel text. Tests live in dataVisualizationLogic.test.ts.
